name: Manabi Juku
description: Manabi Juku — a theme for an after-school tutoring school (cram school), laid out as split screens under a formal white top header with a suou rule: the school name and tagline on the left, the menu across the middle of the bar and a Book a free trial lesson button on the right (an overlay menu on phones). Suou crimson (#8E354A) is the main colour, textured with a fine white grid-paper pattern: the left half of the hero, the school-year half, the story band and every page head are crimson fields in white type. The hero is a product grid in a split screen: the title, lead, buttons and last spring's results on the crimson half, four course tiles (maths, English, science, exam preparation) on the paper half, and a cut-out stack of books (transparent WebP) sitting on the seam and breaking past the hero bottom edge; a cut-out desk lamp breaks over the story band and every page head. The courses run as ruled rows beside a sticky intro, and the school years as a grid beside a crimson heading half. Every picture is a realistic high-key photograph of a modern, international school setting. BIZ UDGothic for display, Barlow for reading, Noto Sans TC for Traditional Chinese headings. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical labels only in Chinese and Japanese. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: Illustration only: the plan row says 3d-clay, and the 2026-10-18 image rule turns every new commercial theme to realistic photographs, so 3d-clay became the high-key photo direction (85mm f/2.8, large softbox fill, near-white background, very soft shadows, graded toward suou crimson), which keeps the bright, soft, rounded feel of clay renders. pattern-texture = a fine white grid-paper pattern (assets/images/pattern.webp) over every crimson field.

summary.zh-TW: 蘇芳紅的課後補習班：左右分割版面、頂部橫向選單、方格紙紋理色塊、四門課程磚格與破框的去背書堆，高調寫實照片，含五種語言樣本。
summary.en: A suou-crimson cram school: split screens, a top-bar menu, grid-paper fields, a course-tile hero with a cut-out book stack breaking out.
summary.ja: 蘇芳色の学習塾。左右分割のレイアウト、上部の横並びメニュー、方眼紙の色面、講座タイルと枠を越える本の切り抜き。
summary.fr: Un soutien scolaire rouge suou : écrans partagés, menu en barre, fonds quadrillés, grille de cours et pile de livres détourée qui déborde.
summary.de: Eine Nachhilfeschule in Suou-Rot: geteilte Flächen, Menüleiste oben, Karopapier-Felder, Kurskacheln und ein freigestellter Bücherstapel.
